tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// kha 'bar ma dkar mo la brten nas 'chi ba bslu zhing bar gcod bzlog pa'i thabs 'chi med bde ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang gi bka' lung bdud rtsi'i zegs ma yang*// su zhig snying gi yol gor lhung tsam gyis// srid zhi'i bde legs 'tsho khams brling byed pa// thub mchog lha brgya'i mgon po gtsug tu mchod// kha 'bar gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas// lus can bar chad 'chi rigs bslu ba'i thabs// rgyal ba'i bka' dang pad 'byung zhal lung gi /dgongs don nyams su blang bde'i sgron ma 'degs// de'ang 'dir kha 'bar ma dkar mo'i lag len ngag 'don gyi rim pa la/ zan gyis ngar mi chang bu mtheb kyu zan ril rnams mang nyung ji ltar rigs par byas nas/ rin po che'i snod gtsang mar ngar mi gcig chang bu gcig mtheb kyu gcig ril bu gcig rnams bshams nas/ thog mar sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs tshar gsum gyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ sngon gcung dga' bo gtor ma 'di la brten nas tshe ring ba dang nad med pa dang*/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur pa/ de bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma la 'jug par bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod pas chos thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog dkar po tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar yi ge a dkar po re res mtshan pa'i skur gyur zhes gsal btab la/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po la sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/

mu ni'i sngags ji ltar 'tsham par bzlas/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ ji snyed su dag nas phyir bsngo'o zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ de dag gi spyan sngar 'khod bzhin pas/ mgron dgug pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ yi dwags kyi gtso mo kha 'bar mas gtso byas pa'i yi dwags gaṅgā klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa thams cad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' lung rjes su dran pa dang bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma'i mgron du skad cig gis mchis par gyur cig oṃ ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas bkug la/ snod cig tu glud re dang*/ chang bu re dang*/ mtheb kyu re dang*/ ril bu re bshams pa chus bran pa'i gtor ma la dmigs nas/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge a dkar pos mtshan par gyur/ bdag nyid shākya thub par gsal ba'i phyag mthil gyi a gnyis las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar po dpag tu med pa nar gyi byung ba'i gtor snod kyi a la babs/ a de dag kyang zhu ba las byung ba'i glud dang gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyag gnyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas gtor ma la gtad/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag dang sbyin bdag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes sngags mjug tu se gol gtogs pa re dang bcas pa lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis bsngos pas/ yi dwags kyi gtso mo kha 'bar mas gtsor byas pa'i yi dwags gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa rnams glud dang gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba 'dis tshim zhing re ba thams cad khengs par gyur cig ces dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// zhes sogs nas/ thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces pas bsngos la gtor glud chu dang bcas pa snod gcig tu dor/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pa gang 'grub byas pa'i rjes su/ snod de chus bkang la bden stobs brjod pa'i phyir/ snying gar thal mo sbyar la/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin brlabs kyis sbyin bdag che ge mos gtsor byas pa'i bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad kyi rigs su gyur pa rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa ste nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa lha'i gdon dang*/ klu'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ dri za'i gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon dang*/ rgyal po'i gdon la sogs pa gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gdon thams cad zhi bar gyur cig bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa bdud/ btsan/ rgyal po/ pe har/ dmu/ ma mo/ gshin rje dam sri la sogs bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de dag sde tshan re re'i mthar yang thal mo gsum gsum brdab/ khyad par yi dwags gtso mo kha 'bar ma la sogs pa'i yi dwags gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa de rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par tshe'i mda' dar/

g.yon pas tshe'i bum pa thogs nas/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i bla tshe yar ba/ nyams pa/ 'thor ba sogs dang*/ 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi tshe bcud thams cad mda' dar gyis bkug nas bum par bstim par bsam zhing mda' dar dang tshe bum rang gi lag tu thogs la/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na ma saṃ ghā ya/ tadya thā/ iṭṭe/ baṭṭe/ naṭṭe/ ku naṭṭe/ ṭakke/ ṭhakke/ ṭha rakke/ u ru ma ti/ ru ru ma ti/ ru ru hilli milli/ sabba dzñā/ du pa dagga na maḥ sabba/ samma/ sa mudzdzha nī/ sidzdzñāntu me mant+ra pā dāḥswā hā/ zhes pa sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe gzungs di ri ri bzla bar bsams la/ rang nyid kyis tshe gzungs ci rigs par bzlas mthar/ tshe'i mda' dar dang bum pa gnyis bsgrub bya rnams kyi mgo bor g.yab cing lag tu gtad nas bsgrub bya des kyang shes na tshe gzungs tshar bdun sogs bzlar gzhug mi shes na rang gis brjod la/ de nas de rnams kyis dga' mgu yi rangs pa'i sems kyi phyir 'gro ba na/ chos kyi sbyin pas phyin chad kyang gnod pa mi byed par gdams pa ni/ rang nyid shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes pa nas 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ zhes dang*/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis// tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar// bsad dang bcings dang brdeg pa dang*// phrogs dang brkus pa la sogs pa'i// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba rnams// 'dod yon rin chen ngar glud dang*// mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim gyur nas// lan chags sha 'khon byang ba dang*// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// tshe srog brkus phrogs gzhom pa rnams// da lta nyid du tshur byin la// rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng sogs nas/ sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ zhes brjod pas phyir song bar bsams la/ glud gtor dang bcas pa phyi rol gtsang sar dor/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa zhes sogs dang*/

sems can nad pa ji snyed sogs dang*/ sman rnams mthu dang ldan pa zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba dang*/ che ba'i che mchog la sogs pa bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// thub dbang gsang ba sngags kyi rgya che bar// byin rlabs gtor mas grangs med yi dwags mgron// tshim par bstabs pa 'chi med bde ster 'di// bgyis pas 'gro la phan bde 'byung gyur cig /ces kha 'bar ma dkar mo la brten nas 'chi ba bslu zhing bar gcod bzlog pa'i thabs 'chi med bde ster zhes bya ba 'di ni/ slob dpon rin po ches lho brag gnam skas can du klu bdud nag po'i lto bar sbas pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis zab gter nas spyan drangs pa'i dgongs don dang rig 'dzin dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa kha 'gengs cung zad kyang bgyis te nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// 'chi ba bslu ba'i gdams pa ches zab ring 'tsho'i dpal ster bzhugs// ༄༅// 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma dang*// nyi ma'i gnyen la phyag bgyis nas// 'chi bslu'i gdams pa ches zab pa// nyams su blang bde 'dir spel lo// khro bu lo tsā ba'i lugs kyi 'chi ba bslu ba'i gtor ma btang ba'i tshul ni 'og tu dgos pa'i dkar gtor nyer bsdogs byas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ bdag yi dam gang rung du bsgom gsungs kyang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i dbu nas 'byung ba'i thub pa rdo rje gdan pa gtso 'khor gyi bsgom bzlas byas mthar/ 'khor gnyis dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim pa'i bar nyams su blang na legs/ de nas mdun du dkar gtor lo grangs lta bu mang du bshams pa de chus bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan mang du brjod pas gtor ma de rnams/ gang 'chi ba bslu ba'i mi de 'dra ba grangs mang por byin gyis brlabs te/

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang ngag tu/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi= chos can rgyu 'gras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyi brlabs kyis/ sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs nad bdag yams bdag 'chi bdag pho mo gang yin pa de dag thams cad 'chi bslu'i srog glud len pa'i phyir skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭa ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes lan gsum gyis bkug la/ thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas/ gnod byed kyi gdon des gtso byas pa'i mgron rigs rnams la bsngos pa so sor thob cing bkres rngabs thams cad sangs bar bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas de rnams gzugs bzang ba thob par bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas de rnams na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur par bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas de rnams bsngos pa so sor thob pa la gzhan gyi gnod 'tshe'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur par bsams la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ zhes kha 'bar ma'i sngags bdun gyis/ rang gi mdun du gnod byed de gcan gzan la sogs pa'i rnam pa can du kha gdangs pa mang du yod par bsams la/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'chi bslu'i mi de 'dra ba bskyed pa de rnams khar mgo mjug bzlog ste/ dbang med du btsangs par bsams zhing mdun gyi gtor snod du dor/

slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan dang sngags lan bdun re la de 'dra ba re re bya/ de ltar lo grangs lta bu mang nyung ji ltar rigs par byas rjes su/ lan chags thams cad bral bar gyur cig bu lon thams cad khyer bar gyur cig sha 'khon thams cad byang bar gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas rang nyid thub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ nyon cig mchod sbyin bstabs pa'i mgron// deng gi sbyin bdag che ge mo'i// lus la rnam par 'tshe byed pa'i// nad bdag yams bdag pho mo dang*// 'chi bdag bdud rigs 'khor bcas rnams// glud 'di bzhes la tshe srog byin// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// ma tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs// rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cig /dul zhing yang dag sdom la sogs nas/ gdon rnams rang rang gnas su deng zhes dang*/ sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ sarba pre ta gatstsha/ na maḥs manta kā ya wāktsitta sogs khro bo'i sngags brjod cing gdon rnams rang gnas su song bar bsams la/ gtor ma de rnams nad pa'i lo bdud yod pa'i phyogs su btang ste/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrungs la/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs dang*/ sems can nad pa sogs dang*/ sman rnams mthu dang sogs smon lam dang bkra shis gang shes kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'di sdig che bas gzhan la mi spel zhes chos rje lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis gsungs so// lo chen zhal lung rgya mtsho'i bcud// ring 'tsho tshe dpal bskyed pa 'di// rnam gsal bgyis pas 'gro ba kun// 'chi bdag dgra las rgyal gyur cig /ces khro phu lo tsā'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i 'chi bslu'i gdams pa ring 'tsho'i dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'chi bslu'i cho ga rgyas pa mang du mi nus pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ nyams su blang bde ba'i kha 'gengs cung zad dang bcas te/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
